fileType.title: File Type
fileType.description: Folded file icons for 99 extensions in 11 families, with four visual styles and six sizes. Uses Zeron's categorical color pairs and semantic surfaces in light and dark themes.
fileType.infoItemDemoDescription: Use 32px file icons with a file name, description, and size. Place FileType directly beside InfoItemContent to preserve its size.
fileType.tableDemoDescription: Use 18px file icons in compact table rows. Long names truncate while the file type and size remain visible.
fileType.extension: Extension with or without a leading dot; case insensitive. Takes precedence over fileName.
fileType.fileName: Literal file name or path, or an absolute URL. Detects the final extension and supplies the default accessible name; only URL queries and fragments are excluded from detection.
fileType.variant: Outline: surface and colored badge. Solid: colored page. Light: muted page and colored badge. Mono: neutral badge.
fileType.size: Square icon bounds: mini 18px, xs 24px, sm 32px, default 40px, lg 48px, xl 56px.
fileType.ariaLabel: Overrides the default accessible name. aria-labelledby can also reference an existing label.
fileType.ariaHidden: Hide decorative icons from assistive technology when the adjacent file name already identifies the file.
fileType.className: Additional classes for external layout. Use size and variant for icon geometry and appearance.
fileType.ref: Reference to the root SVG element. Other native SVG attributes are forwarded.
fileType.fallbackNote: Unknown extensions use a neutral badge. Names without a suffix, such as README or .gitignore, show FILE. Long unknown labels are shortened visually while the accessible name stays complete.
fileType.helpers: Also exports fileTypeFamilies, fileTypeVariants, and resolveFileType. The resolver accepts extension and fileName and returns the normalized extension, full label, family, and categorical color.
